meta.title: SRIJAN 2K26 | Inter-College Hackathon, SRMCEM Lucknow
meta.description: Two days, your idea. Screening online on 13 Oct, finale at SRMCEM Lucknow on 14 Oct. Teams of one to four.

event.name: SRIJAN
event.venueFull: Shri Ramswaroop Memorial College of Engineering & Management, Lucknow
event.eligibility: Students from SRMCEM and other colleges

about.heading: Ideas in. Prototypes out.
body: SRIJAN 2K26 is an inter-college hackathon that brings together students, developers, innovators and technology enthusiasts to build practical solutions to real-world problems.
It pushes students beyond theoretical learning, turning ideas into working prototypes through teamwork, technology and problem-solving.

explainer.heading: New to hackathons?
explainer.text: A hackathon is an event where small teams turn an idea into a working prototype and present it to judges.

cards.d: One event in two formats: an online round first, then an in-person finale.
Students from SRMCEM and other colleges can take part.
Join solo or bring a team of up to four.
The finale is hosted on campus in Lucknow, the City of Nawabs.

tracks.heading: Six domains. Pick your battlefield.

items.title: Autonomous AI Agent Evaluation and Reliability Engine
items.text: A testing platform that tries tricky scenarios on AI agents in sandboxes and flags where they fail.

items.title: Zero-Trust Autonomous Agent Security & Sidecar Sandbox Engine
items.text: A security layer that watches what AI agents do, limits what they can access, and blocks unsafe actions.

items.title: Autonomous Multi-Cloud FinOps & Infrastructure Self-Healing Fabric
items.text: A system that tests how cloud infrastructure fails, helps lower cloud costs, and suggests fixes to reduce downtime.

items.title: Real-Time Autonomous Supply Chain Resiliency & Graph Replanning
items.text: A digital twin that uses threat and delay data to spot likely logistics bottlenecks and propose alternate routes.

items.title: Distributed Smart Grid Real-Time Load & Energy Orchestrator
items.text: A control system for smart meters and battery micro-grids that helps balance power load.

items.title: Automated Regulatory Compliance & Code Refactoring Engine
items.text: A tool that maps legal rules to a codebase to find privacy issues and propose code fixes.

items.title: Closed-Loop Clinical Decision Support & Patient Trajectory Engine
items.text: A healthcare AI that combines patient records and vitals to flag patients who may be getting worse.

items.title: Decentralized Anti-Money Laundering (AML) & Fraud Graph Engine
items.text: A privacy-preserving graph engine that spots suspicious patterns across financial transaction streams.

items.title: Predictive Natural Disaster Relief & Autonomous Resource Dispatch
items.text: A crisis tool that combines satellite, drone and SOS data to assess damage and route rescue teams.

items.title: Explainable Credit Risk & Bias-Mitigated Underwriting Platform
items.text: A credit-scoring platform that uses alternative financial data, aims for fairness, and explains decisions to applicants.

items.title: Precision AgTech Micro-Climate & Disease Predictive Engine
items.text: A farming tool that combines satellite imagery and field sensors to predict crop disease and guide treatment.

items.title: Autonomous Software Refactoring & Technical Debt Remediation Agent
items.text: An agent that maps code dependencies, finds architectural debt, and helps carry out upgrades with tests.

items.title: Cross-Silo Enterprise Knowledge Discovery & Graph Engine
items.text: A knowledge graph linking team tools (Slack, Jira, Docs, GitHub) to give accurate, permission-aware answers.

items.title: Smart Urban Traffic & Emergency Vehicle Corridor Orchestrator
items.text: An edge-based traffic system that uses camera feeds to tune signals and clear paths for emergency vehicles.

items.title: High-Frequency Market Manipulation & Spoofing Detector
items.text: A fast market-surveillance pipeline that reads order-book data to detect spoofing and other manipulation.

cards: Building systems that learn from data to predict, classify, generate or automate decisions that normally need human judgement.
Designing and building websites and mobile or desktop apps that people use through browsers and devices.
Protecting systems, networks and data from unauthorised access, attacks and misuse.
Technology ideas, such as connected devices, automation and data tools, that make a campus safer, more efficient and easier to use.
Solutions that reduce environmental harm or address community needs such as health, education and accessibility.
A free-choice theme for original ideas that do not fit the other five but solve a real problem.
tracks.intro: Each domain is a theme for your idea. The note under each is general background, not an event rule.
lines: Teach software to learn, predict and help people decide.
Turn an idea into something people can open and use.
Protect people, data and systems from misuse.
Use connected technology to make campus life simpler and safer.
Use technology to help communities and the planet.
Have a different idea? Bring it.

days.blurb: The first round is held online.
The second day is in person at SRMCEM Campus, Lucknow, with demos, judging and rewards.

items.a: Students from SRMCEM and other participating colleges and universities.
An event where teams turn an idea into a working prototype and present it. SRIJAN 2K26 is for building practical solutions to real-world problems.
The event runs in two formats. Day 1 (13 Oct) is the online screening and Day 2 (14 Oct) is the offline finale at SRMCEM Campus, Lucknow.

items.q: How big can a team be?
items.a: Teams of 1 to 4 members, so you can join solo.
₹50 per team member: ₹50 for 1, ₹100 for 2, ₹150 for 3, ₹200 for 4.
items.closedA: Registration is closed. The fee was ₹50 per team member: ₹50 for 1, ₹100 for 2, ₹150 for 3, ₹200 for 4.

items.a: Registration closes on 11 Oct 2026 at 12:00 PM IST.
Teams submit an idea in the registration form. Shortlisted teams are announced on 12 Oct, based on the ideas submitted.
On 12 Oct, based on the ideas submitted in the registration form.
At SRMCEM Campus, Lucknow, on 14 Oct.
There are six: AI & ML, Web & App Development, Cybersecurity, Smart Campus Solutions, Sustainability & Social Impact, and Open Innovation. Problem statements are announced soon.
Rewards worth ₹1.5 Lakh+. The breakdown is announced soon.
